claims.claim: It is a Spinning Fitness Bike
claims.evidence: Report identifies a stationary exercise bike with “The Cycling Machine” near the rear wheel; brand and model are null.
Age and usage history are not shown and cannot be determined from photos.
Resistance adjustment and stable operation are not shown; function cannot be confirmed from static photos.
Condition of the frame including rust is not shown in the report.
Original parts, manual, tools, and warranty documents are not shown.

risks.risk: Console does not power on or display metrics
risks.proof: Video clip of the console turning on and showing metrics

risks.risk: Resistance levels do not adjust smoothly
risks.proof: Clip of resistance being adjusted through all levels while pedaling
risks.if_unproven: priced as resistance faulty or non-adjustable

risks.risk: Seat, pedals, or frame have scratches, rust, or cracks
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the seat, pedals, frame joints, and any visible wear
risks.if_unproven: priced with significant cosmetic and structural wear

risks.risk: Bike is older or more heavily used than claimed
risks.if_unproven: priced as an older, heavily used unit

risks.risk: Bike is not stable or makes noise during operation
risks.proof: Video of the bike in operation at various speeds showing stability and noise
risks.if_unproven: priced as untested or not working

proof_requests: Video of the console powering on and displaying metrics
Clip of resistance adjustment through all levels
Close-up photos of seat, pedals, and frame condition
Original purchase receipt or proof of age
Video of the bike being pedaled to check stability and noise
response.reason: The witness identifies the item as a stationary exercise bike, so it can be priced at its worst case; proof of function and condition would raise the value.
